name: Nonday Laboratory
detail: The room is very clean overall, and the front desk staff are gentle and warm-hearted. They can communicate in both English and Korean, and one of the staff members even speaks Chinese. When checking in, they will provide you with a detailed process, and they offer slippers, shampoo, conditioner, and body wash. During the day, this place operates as a coffee shop, creating a nice atmosphere. They serve breakfast in the morning with milk, toast, and cereal. Each room has a password, and the privacy of the beds is quite good with blackout curtains, and there are lights and sockets inside the beds. Moreover, this place is located in the city center, directly across from Dongmen Market, and it's convenient to reach the duty-free shop and the airport. You can also take public transportation to East Line and West Line attractions, which is very convenient. If I visit again, I will definitely consider this place. It's fantastic!

name: Hotel Fine Jeju
detail: Located at the center of Seogwipo City, it was convenient to move east and west, and there were several parking lots nearby, making parking easy. The breakfast was delicious, especially the porridge, bulgogi, and spicy pork. The staff greeted us with smiles in the morning as well. The room condition was also good. It was suitable for three people in a two-bed room, and towels were changed daily. I think I will use it again next time.

name: HOTEL NANTA JEJU
detail: The bedding is really neat and cozy!! There is also a baby bed guard. The microwave is usable! The view of both the sea and the mountains was very nice. I heard the breakfast is delicious, but I couldn't use it this time. I will definitely try it next time.
area: Halla Mountain National Park,Jeju - View on map

name: Gwandeok Stay
detail: First of all, I want to compliment the kind boss, who not only helped heat up the food but also provided me with disposable gloves and garbage bags. I really appreciate it; my dog was drooling, haha. Secondly, regarding the location, it's less than a 5-minute walk to the East Gate Market, which is very convenient. Lastly, I have to mention that the hygiene was somewhat lacking; although the host prepared clean sheets, I could still see hair from the previous guest. Everything else was quite nice, and the eight-person room was also spacious.

name: Aimi Jeju Beach Hotel Hamdeok W
detail: I was very pleased and moved throughout my stay of over a week until last Wednesday! The room was cozy and well-decorated. I came with a sick leave, but even though I spent a lot of time in the room, it was comfortable and enjoyable. The sea is right in front, and the bus stop is just behind. The room layout, view, and location were all great! The maids provided a warm smile and took care of necessary items and cleaning promptly, and the staff at the front desk were always kind and attentive whenever I stopped by, for which I am truly grateful. *^^* I'm a late sleeper, so I don't usually have breakfast, but the breakfast here was wonderful! There were many options, and they were delicious! I couldn't believe the quality at this price. The service, view, and location are all top-notch!!!

name: Kenny Stay Jeju Seogwipo (Hotel Kenny)
detail: I was happy to be able to sleep in a comfortable and clean bedroom at a price of around 30,000 won. However, since it was an SUV, the parking lot was full, so I parked in a public parking lot across the street. I heard that regular cars can enter the parking tower. You can do self check-in/check-out at the kiosk. There was a staff member when I checked in, and they were very kind and informed me of nearby events, allowing me to enjoy my last night after initially planning just to sleep there. Thank you! The Olle Market is open until 9 PM, and it was nice to explore with plenty of food options available. There’s a delicious korokke place! Since there’s no breakfast, you can use the convenience store on the first floor or buy some rice balls at the night market in advance. They have a coin laundry, and the bathroom is narrow, which might be uncomfortable when sitting on the toilet and getting dressed. I recommend it if you're looking for a clean and tidy accommodation with good value for money!

name: Backpacker's Home
detail: The transportation is very convenient; if you want to walk the Olle, the starting point of Line 7 is right at the entrance. Not to mention how friendly the staff are; even if you're alone, everyone will take care of your feelings. Originally, I only booked for two nights but ended up staying for a total of four nights. Breakfast allows you to fry your own eggs, and besides coffee and orange juice, there are also milk and cereal. The bonfire is great; everyone can gather around to chat, and this is the place in Korea where I've seen the most Europeans 😂 I'm very happy to chat with everyone. The BBQ activity is also great, and I felt very full.

name: Shinshin Hotel Cheonjiyeon
detail: A trip planned with just my husband, focusing on cost-effective accommodations. Our first stop was Cheonjiyeon, where we enjoyed three nights with breakfast at a fantastic price. There are many restaurants nearby, and places like Olle Market, Ogeumjeong Kimbap, Cheonjiyeon, Cheongbang, and Chilsimni Park are all within walking distance, making it a great place for those who prefer to walk. However, perhaps because it is the cheapest among other hotels, the room size was small, and they mentioned that they couldn't provide many towels. The carpeted floor felt a bit dirty, and the hygiene situation was somewhat lacking. Nevertheless, I acknowledge that it is an excellent hotel in terms of value for money.

name: Playce Camp Jeju
detail: The room was a bit cramped for two people, but the bedding and bathroom were clean, so overall it was satisfying. Considering the price, the room condition is quite good in terms of value for money, and the availability of various facilities and airport shuttle services is also a significant advantage.

name: Linden Guest house
detail: After staying with my son from August 13 to 15, I attended the alumni circle event on the evening of August 30 and stayed over. 1. Advantages - Extremely high cost-effectiveness and location (close to the airport, intercity bus terminal, international ferry terminal, etc... and also convenient for Yeondong and Tapdong) - If you're open-minded, it is possible to meet global people. Although they are not particularly wealthy, it was fine. 2. Disadvantages (perhaps too minor to complain given the price...) - Parking can be difficult. It might be okay for a motorcycle... - The bathroom feels like accommodations from school trips in the 80s and 90s... Need to bring your own towels, toothbrushes, etc. There are no amenities like that. - The woman at the counter is a foreigner, but if you don't get surprised and speak English, it's fine. She provides good service. - I'm not sure how to connect the TV in the room. Haha.
